{{Top|leg}}
The '''Depot''' was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] privately dubbed name for an area of space controlled by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces five years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>

Thrawn's flagship, the ''[[Chimaera/Legends|Chimaera]]'', was patrolling this area of space when the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Judicator/Legends|Judicator]]'' came upon the missing [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' Fleet]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] force led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] sent to investigate it. Thrawn ordered the ''Chimaera'' to leave the Depot and join the fight to recover the newly discovered fleet, but they were waylaid by the arrival of the mad [[Jedi Master]] [[Joruus C'baoth|Joruus C'Baoth]] in a stolen [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]].<ref name="DFR" />
